teach.text: To add, start at the bigger number and count on. 8 + 4: start at 8. Count on 4: 9, 10, 11, 12. So 8 and 4 make 12. You can add in any order. 3 + 8 is the same as 8 + 3.
teach.reteach: Make ten first, then add what is left. 9 + 3: 9 needs 1 more to make 10. Take 1 from the 3. Now 2 are left. 10 and 2 make 12.
